answer: Proof of Personhood functions as a vital beacon for Sybil resistance in AI economies by anchoring digital identities to unique biological traits. Unlike ephemeral accounts, this mechanism forces an attacker to traverse a metaphorical tundra of high-entropy biometric verification hurdles. Each identity is a reef of verified data, creating an inescapable cost: the attacker must pay the full physical and capital expense of authenticating every singular human actor to bypass the network.
